title: The Illusion of Relief: How GenAI Redistributes Cognitive Workload in Software Organizations
abstract: arXiv:2611.23286v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This study explores how Generative AI (GenAI) reshapes software practitioners' cognitive work across software development activities. We analyzed questionnaire responses from 44 practitioners across nine organizations using descriptive quantitative methods and qualitative analysis of relevant open-ended responses. Practitioners reported productivity and time savings, but also effort associated with providing context, prompting, reviewing, correcting, verifying, and integrating AI-generated outputs. Human judgment and accountability remained central, with practitioners anticipating a shift from direct code production to guiding, evaluating, validating, integrating, and coordinating AI-supported work. Thus, GenAI appears to redistribute cognitive work toward oversight rather than simply eliminate it, although whether overall cognitive workload increases or decreases remains undetermined.

translated_title: 轻松的错觉：生成式AI如何在软件组织中重新分配认知工作量
translated_abstract: 本研究探讨了生成式人工智能如何重塑软件从业者在软件开发活动中的认知工作。我们采用描述性定量方法以及对相关开放式回答的定性分析，分析了来自九个组织的44名从业者的问卷回答。从业者报告了生产力和时间上的节省，但同时也报告了与提供上下文、编写提示、审查、纠正、验证以及整合AI生成输出相关的工作投入。人类判断与问责始终处于核心地位，从业者预计其角色将从直接的代码生产转向对AI支持工作的指导、评估、验证、整合与协调。因此，GenAI似乎是将认知工作重新分配至监督层面，而非简单地将其消除，尽管整体认知工作量究竟是增加还是减少仍尚无定论。
tldr: 研究表明生成式AI并未消除软件从业者的认知工作，而是将其重新分配——从业者从直接编写代码转向提供上下文、审查验证和协调AI输出等监督性工作，人类判断与问责仍然是核心。
en_tdlr: GenAI does not eliminate cognitive work but redistributes it toward oversight, as software practitioners shift from direct code production to contextualizing, reviewing, verifying, and integrating AI-generated outputs, with human judgment and accountability remaining central.
